newsitem.title: PERU: Peru year-on-year GDP growth 6.5 percent in May.
newsitem.headline: Peru year-on-year GDP growth 6.5 percent in May.

text.p: The Peruvian economy grew 6.5 percent year-on-year in May, compared with 2.5 percent year-on-year growth in the same month last year, the government's statistics agency said Thursday.

The National Statistics and Information Institute (INEI) also reported year-on-year Gross Domestic Product growth in the first five months of the year was 7.2 percent, compared with 1.1 percent in the January-May period of 1996.
The May figure was Peru's second highest year-on-year monthly growth figure so far in 1997, after April's 13.4 percent.
The government estimates Peru is headed for overall year-on-year GDP growth of at least five percent in 1997. GDP grew 2.8 percent in 1996 and 7.0 percent in 1995.
